proposal.utterance: Classify 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity.

entities.label: AgentConnectedness
entities.rationale: Agent connectedness is a property that inheres in agents (or collections of agents) — it characterizes how connected an agent is to others within a network or system. As a measurable, bearer-dependent property it best fits BFO Quality (BFO_0000019), a specifically dependent continuant. It is not a role (externally conferred social function), not a disposition (internally grounded capacity for a particular process), and not a process itself. The existing working class RelationalCoherence (also Quality) is related in spirit but pertains to coherence among relational elements; AgentConnectedness is distinct in that it characterizes the degree or fact of inter-agent linkage for a particular bearer.

relations.rationale: AgentConnectedness is classified as a subclass of BFO Quality, inheriting the constraint that instances must inhere in exactly one bearer.

open_questions: Should AgentConnectedness be a sub-quality of an existing working class such as RelationalCoherence, or remain a direct subclass of BFO Quality?

Is 'agent connectedness' intended as a dyadic relational quality between two agents (which in BFO 2020 would be modeled as a relational quality inhering in a pair), or a monadic quality of a single agent reflecting its overall degree of connectedness?
Is this intended to range over legal agents specifically (e.g., parties to a legal relationship), or agents in general (including social/institutional agents)?
Could 'agent connectedness' instead be a Disposition (BFO_0000016) — a capacity to engage relationally — rather than a Quality reflecting an already-realized state of connection?
proposal.rationale_summary: The utterance asks for an ontological classification of 'agent connectedness' as a kind of entity. Because agent connectedness describes a property that inheres in an agent (or an agent pair/collective) — namely how or to what degree that agent is connected to others — it best fits BFO Quality (BFO_0000019), a specifically dependent continuant that characterizes its bearer at a time. It is minted as a new class AgentConnectedness, subClassOf BFO_0000019. No existing working class exactly captures inter-agent linkage as a quality; RelationalCoherence covers relational coherence of a legal structure and NetworkNode covers node-level position, both of which are related but distinct. Several open questions are flagged because the exact bearer-type, whether it is monadic or relational, and whether it is better typed as Disposition rather than Quality, depend on further specification by the user.
